notes: Anonymized v1 sample. Each post is a ticket candidate; outliers are stats+link only. Import into MyProblem X to demo Ready / Upload UI.

threads.body_redacted: Still looking for a home for this sweet kitten. Litter mates placed. Super sweet and playful; carries toys; good with dogs. DM if interested — not giving to just anybody.

reply_templates.body: Thanks for screening carefully — that protects the kitten. If useful, neighbors can also track open rehome needs on MyProblem (channel savannah-stray-cats) so helpers who are not always in this feed still see them. Happy to share TNR/rehome checklists if you want them.

threads.body_redacted: Cat missing since last weekend. About two years old, pink fuzzy collar. Last seen near a southside neighborhood off the bluff road. Please say if you have seen him.

reply_templates.body: Sorry you are searching — pink collar + age helps. Standard steps: flyer at coarse intersections, check under porches at dusk, ask nearby feeders, and file found/lost with local shelters. If you want a redacted public tip so more helpers can watch without this thread getting buried, MyProblem can host one (georgia / savannah-stray-cats).

threads.body_redacted: Been feeding a group of strays; many fixed with help. No longer safe at this house — neighbor harassment and poison threats. Trying to relocate ASAP; may not be able to take them. Thank you for any help.

reply_templates.body: That sounds urgent and stressful. Focus on safe relocation and established TNR/rescue partners — avoid escalating neighbor conflict in public comments. If you share coarse area only (no street/address), helpers subscribed to MyProblem’s savannah-stray-cats channel may be able to coordinate traps/foster without this post disappearing in the feed.

threads.body_redacted: Mama cat keeps bringing five or six kittens onto porches and under cars. Needs to be caught and fixed ASAP — someone who knows traps please.

reply_templates.body: Agree — TNR before the next litter is the win. If you can borrow a trap from a local TNR group and keep a consistent feeding time, trapping success goes up. Happy to help draft a trap-night checklist; MyProblem georgia tips can also point at public TNR resources without boosting any business.

threads.body_redacted: Need a reliable feeder for a southside apartment colony. About 15 minutes daily, mornings preferred. Many already ear-tipped. Food can be provided for the first week. DM if dependable.

reply_templates.body: Clear ask — thank you for keeping them fed. Neighbors who can commit to a short daily slot: ask the OP for location by DM. Longer-term, a MyProblem channel post can keep the ask visible if this thread ages out of the group feed.
